title: State-space models
equipment: Two connected water tanks and an inlet pump
physicalPurpose: Represent each independent water store and the flows connecting them.
principalTechnique: State-space model from coupled volume balances
objective: Derive and compare both local tank-state predictions against the coupled nonlinear mass balances.

simplifications: Equal fixed cross sections and discharge coefficients; free upstream discharge without downstream backpressure.
Physical levels use coupled RK4 gravity balances; the ST predictor is a separate local one-second Euler approximation.

baseline.limitation: The local Euler prediction approximates the nonlinear balances and never replaces physical levels.

change.decision: Require matching initial derivative signs and magnitudes within five percent, and both model-level errors within 0.001 m through 20 seconds.

disturbances: Fresh initial state h1=.27 m, h2=.25 m; pump deviation 0 or +.001 m3/s for 20 s, then nominal .010 m3/s for 100 s.

acceptance.window: first 20 seconds after a fresh synchronized start
first 20 seconds after a fresh synchronized start

learning.context: Two freely discharging tanks store water before it reaches the downstream measurement.
learning.reason: One level alone cannot describe both stored volumes.
learning.change: Derive both nonlinear balances and their local state-space approximation.
learning.transfer: Controllability asks what one pump can influence over time.
theory: The internal transfer cancels in total stored volume; each local matrix row retains its physical balance.
learning.workedPrediction: At x=[.02,0] and v=0, local level rates are[-.0008,.0008] m/s; adding .001 m3/s changes the first to .0012 m/s.
practicalPreparation: Use a fresh synchronized runtime/plant start; a running unequal-level cascade cannot hold its initial state while preparing.
learning.baseline: Compare both local predictions with the nonlinear nominal-flow response.
learning.comparison: Repeat the same initial state with +.001 m3/s input for 20 seconds.
learning.validation: Check derivative agreement and both level errors before accepting the local approximation.
learning.explanation: A state-space model tracks both stores and separates input flow from measured downstream level.

abortPredicates: Level outside .05–.45 m, requested flow outside0–.020 m3/s, invalid data or a non-one-second clock interval.
safety.restorationMode: Normal completion restores .010 m3/s; early abort commands zero and requires simulator stop/reset.
simulationOnlyRestrictions: The result is simulation evidence for this lesson model.

video.viewerOutcome: Derive and compare both local tank-state predictions against the coupled nonlinear mass balances.
